beginner.append: Read the figures in the NPV Scenario Builder with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping.
beginner.why: The cards and cashflow print compact money ("$45M") that cannot carry a 0.001 $MM tolerance; the tornado prints 1 decimal.

advanced.append: Read the figures in the NPV Scenario Builder and the Probabilistic Breakeven Analyzer with their Full precision switch on (at the top of each page): they print them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping. With it on, the Builder's Risk tab shows the Monte Carlo settings (iterations, the three ranges and the seed) and an Export sorted sample button, a CSV of every NPV in rank order.
advanced.why: The Builder hard-coded 1000 iterations, 20 percent ranges and its default seed, so the stated Monte Carlo could not be run, and the sample was never shown or exported; the cards print compact money.
